title: EvalDataset
description: Schema for evals/dataset.json — the array of eval cases used by the eval harness.

id.description: Unique case identifier matching an AC-xxx entry from the spec.

mappedIds.description: One or more INV/PROP/GR/FR/AC/SEM identifiers from the spec that this case validates.

expected_exit_code.description: Expected CLI exit code. Defaults to 0. run-eval.js: if actual exit matches → evaluate layers normally; if actual exit 4 and expected_exit_code ≠ 4 → classify as ERROR (excluded from scoring).

referenceNow.description: ISO-8601 datetime with explicit UTC offset used as the reference datetime.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string. Defaults to Asia/Kolkata if omitted.

EvalAssertions.description: Declarative assertions checked by the harness. All fields are optional; harness checks only the ones present.

dueTolerance.description: Tolerance in seconds for due comparison (default 60 for ±1 min; 300 for ±5 min).

dueIsNull.description: If true, asserts that due === null.

titleNonNull.description: If true, asserts that title is a non-empty string.

expected_exit_code.description: Expected CLI exit code (legacy assertions field — prefer top-level EvalCase.expected_exit_code; both accepted by harness).

semChecks.description: SEM-xxx identifiers to evaluate for this case.
